macro(100, 'virar target', function()
 if not g_game.isAttacking() then return end
 local tt = g_game.getAttackingCreature()
 local tx = tt:getPosition().x
 local ty = tt:getPosition().y
 local dir = player:getDirection()
 local tdx = math.abs(tx-pos().x)
 local tdy = math.abs(ty-pos().y)
 if (tdy >= 2 and tdx >= 2) or tdx > 7 or tdy > 7 then return end 
 if tdy >= tdx then
  if ty > pos().y then
   if dir ~= 2 then
    return turn(2)
   end
  else
   if dir ~= 0 then
    return turn(0)
   end
  end
 else
  if tx > pos().x then
   if dir ~= 1 then
    return turn(1)
   end
  else
   if dir ~= 3 then
    return turn(3)
   end
  end
 end
end)

macro(200, "desviar Wave Original", function()
  local effectId = 750
  local playerPos = pos()

  -- check if the player is on a tile with the effect 1804
  local playerTile = g_map.getTile(playerPos)
  if hasEffect(playerTile, effectId) then
    effect = 1
  else
    effect = 0
  end

  -- search for the nearest tile without the effect 1804
  local targetPos = findNearestTileWithoutEffect(effectId, playerPos, 5)
  if not targetPos then
    print("Could not find a target tile")
    return
  end

  -- move to the target tile if the player is standing on a tile with the effect
  if effect == 1 then
    autoWalk(targetPos, 50, { ignoreNonPathable = true, precision = 1 })
    delay(1000)
  end

  -- check if the player is on a tile with the effect 1804 after moving
  local newPlayerTile = g_map.getTile(pos())
  if hasEffect(newPlayerTile, effectId) then
    print("Player is on a tile with effect 1804 after moving")
  end
end)

function hasEffect(tile, effect)
  for _, fx in ipairs(tile:getEffects()) do
    if fx:getId() == effect then
      return true
    end
  end
  return false
end

function findNearestTileWithoutEffect(effectId, centerPos, range)
  local minDist, targetPos = nil, nil
  for x = -range, range do
    for y = -range, range do
      local pos = {x = centerPos.x + x, y = centerPos.y + y, z = centerPos.z}
      local dist = math.abs(x) + math.abs(y)
      if dist > 0 and (not minDist or dist < minDist) then
        local tile = g_map.getTile(pos)
        if tile and not hasEffect(tile, effectId) and g_map.isWalkable(pos) then
          -- tile doesn't have the effect 1804 and is walkable
          minDist = dist
          targetPos = pos
        end
      end
    end
  end
  return targetPos
end

  if not storage[followName].followOn then return end

  local followTarget = storage[followName].player
  if g_game.isFollowing() then
    return
  end

  for _, followcreature in ipairs(g_map.getSpectators(pos(), false)) do
    if (followcreature:getName() == followTarget and getDistanceBetween(pos(), followcreature:getPosition()) <= 8) then
      g_game.follow(followcreature)

  end

  local p = toFollowPos[posz()]
  if not p then
    return

  if autoWalk(p, 20, { ignoreNonPathable = true, precision = 1 }) then

local tempoLimite = 18 -- Tempo em segundos para detectar o travamento (Ajustado para 18s)
local ultimaPosicao = nil
local tempoParado = now

-- ------------------------------------------------------

  text = "Anti-Stuck",

  else
    antiStuckIcon.text:setColoredText({"Anti-Stuck\n", "white", "OFF", "red"})
  end
end)

-- ------------------------------------------------------
-- LÓGICA DA MACRO ANTI-STUCK + KAI
-- ------------------------------------------------------
macro(500, function()
  -- Não executa se o ícone estiver desligado (OFF)
  if not storage.autoAntiStuckEnabled then
    tempoParado = now
    return
  end

  -- Verifica se o CaveBot está ativo no client
  local caveBotAtivo = false
  if storage.CaveBot and storage.CaveBot.enabled then
    caveBotAtivo = storage.CaveBot.enabled
  elseif CaveBot and CaveBot.isActive then
    caveBotAtivo = CaveBot.isActive()
  else
    caveBotAtivo = true 
  end

  if not caveBotAtivo then
    tempoParado = now
    return
  end

  local posAtual = pos()
  if not posAtual then return end

  -- Verifica se mudou de posição ou de andar
  if not ultimaPosicao or ultimaPosicao.x ~= posAtual.x or ultimaPosicao.y ~= posAtual.y or ultimaPosicao.z ~= posAtual.z then
    ultimaPosicao = posAtual
    tempoParado = now
  else
    -- Se continuou na mesma posição, calcula se passou dos 18 segundos
    if now - tempoParado >= (tempoLimite * 1000) then
      -- 1. Solta a habilidade Kai para destravar alvos/stuns
      say("kai")

      -- 2. Força o passo para uma direção aleatória (0=Norte, 1=Leste, 2=Sul, 3=Oeste)
      local direcaoAleatoria = math.random(0, 3)
      walk(direcaoAleatoria)
      
      warn("CaveBot travado! Usando 'kai' e forçando movimento após 18s.")
      
      tempoParado = now
    end
  end
end)
